units.title: 走进咖啡馆
units.subtitle: In the cafe
units.description: 早上的一杯咖啡：温度、价格，还有第一句点单。

panels.caption: It is morning. The cafe is small and warm.
The coffee is hot and cheap. Two coins for a cup.
The tea is not hot. It is cold.
The tea is cheap too. The price is on the wall.

bubbles.speaker: shopkeeper
bubbles.text: Good morning. What would you like?

bubbles.speaker: cat
bubbles.text: A cup of coffee, please. Is it hot?

bubbles.speaker: shopkeeper
bubbles.text: Yes. The coffee is hot and cheap.

feedback.on_wrong: 再想想——正确的是「便宜的」。

units.title: 两枚硬币
units.subtitle: Two coins
units.description: 同样一只杯子，价格可以完全不同。

panels.caption: This cup is expensive. The price is five coins.
The small cup is not expensive. The price is two coins.

feedback.on_wrong: 再想想——正确的是「昂贵的」。

scenes.prompt: This cup is expensive. The ____ is five coins.
哪一句在正文里真的出现过？

options.label: This cup is expensive. The price is five coins.
This cup is cheap. The price is five coins.
This cup is cheaper. The price is five coins.
This cup is cheapest. The price is five coins.

feedback.on_correct: 答对了——「This cup is expensive. The price is five coins.」。
feedback.on_wrong: 再想想——正确的是「This cup is expensive. The price is five coins.」。

units.title: 早晨的声音
units.subtitle: Morning sounds
units.description: 把前两个单元的词放回一个安静的早晨。

panels.caption: In the morning, the cafe is quiet. The coffee is warm.
Some cups are cheap and some are expensive. Every cup is warm.

bubbles.speaker: cat
bubbles.text: In the morning, the cafe is quiet.

bubbles.speaker: shopkeeper
bubbles.text: And the coffee is always warm.
